scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.format: prettier --write scripts src tests *.ts *.json README.md docs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check scripts src tests *.ts *.json README.md docs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check
scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:rust && npm run format:check && npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:lod: vitest run src/atlas/lod.test.ts src/atlas/cityView.test.ts src/atlas/terrainView.test.ts src/atlas/groundView.test.ts src/atlas/presentationCache.test.ts src/atlas/presentationLoader.test.ts
scripts.test:lod:e2e: playwright test lod-navigation.spec.ts world-lod.spec.ts city-view.spec.ts navigation-readiness.spec.ts overview-roads.spec.ts tile-invalidation.spec.ts
scripts.perf:build: vite build --config vite.performance.config.ts && cargo build --release --locked --target-dir src-tauri/target --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example atlas_test_server
